strings.zh: 迷思 1：病毒疣會自己好，不用治療
strings.en: Myth 1: Warts will heal on their own — no treatment needed

strings.zh: 迷思 2：香蕉皮、大蒜、白醋可以治
strings.en: Myth 2: Banana peel, garlic, or white vinegar can cure warts

strings.zh: 迷思 3：冷凍打一次、雷射打一次就消
strings.en: Myth 3: One round of cryotherapy or laser clears them

strings.zh: 迷思 4：自己擠破、剪掉就會好
strings.en: Myth 4: Squeezing or cutting them off works

strings.zh: 迷思 5：HPV 疫苗只防子宮頸癌，跟皮膚的疣沒關係
strings.en: Myth 5: HPV vaccines only prevent cervical cancer, nothing to do with skin warts

strings.zh: 迷思 6：足底疣是雞眼，挫一挫就好
strings.en: Myth 6: Plantar warts are corns — just file them down

strings.zh: 常見問題（PTT / Dcard 上常被問的）
strings.en: Common Questions (frequently asked on PTT / Dcard)

strings.zh: 病毒疣 PTT 推薦的藥膏有用嗎？

strings.en: How long do warts take to clear?

strings.zh: 冷凍 / 雷射打一次多少錢？
strings.en: How much does cryotherapy or laser cost per session?

strings.zh: HPV 疫苗對皮膚的疣有用嗎？
strings.en: Does the HPV vaccine prevent skin warts?

strings.zh: 足底疣跟雞眼怎麼分？健保有給付嗎？
strings.en: How do you distinguish plantar warts from corns? Is treatment covered by NHI?

strings.zh: HPV 型別 × 身體部位 × 外觀對照
strings.en: HPV types × body location × appearance reference

strings.zh: 「自然消退」要看年齡與免疫狀態：
strings.en: "Spontaneous resolution" depends on age and immune status:

strings.zh: HPV 疫苗（九價）涵蓋型別：
健保：液態氮冷凍每次掛號費(NT$ 200-500)，不限治療次數。自費：CO2 雷射 NT$ 1,500-5,000/次、Bleomycin 注射 NT$ 1,000-3,000/次、脈衝染料雷射 NT$ 3,000-8,000/次。多數人健保冷凍 4-6 次就解決。
strings.en: NHI: liquid nitrogen cryotherapy costs only the visit copay (NT$ 200–500), unlimited sessions. Out-of-pocket: CO2 laser NT$ 1,500–5,000/session, bleomycin injection NT$ 1,000–3,000/session, pulsed-dye laser NT$ 3,000–8,000/session. Most patients clear with 4–6 NHI cryotherapy sessions.

strings.zh: 傷口流血含病毒，沾到剪刀指甲，下次再用就把病毒種到別處
strings.en: Wound bleeding contains virus; contaminated scissors or nails reseed the virus elsewhere on next use

strings.zh: 留下難看疤痕，尤其臉部
strings.en: Causes unsightly scarring, especially on the face

strings.zh: 看似消失的病灶在傷口下再生，變得更厚更難治
strings.en: Apparently cleared lesions regrow under the wound, becoming thicker and more refractory

strings.zh: 幾乎都需要 3-6 次以上
strings.en: almost always requires 3–6 or more sessions

strings.zh: 真正關鍵不是哪一種治療最強，而是規則回診不中斷
strings.en: The real key isn't which treatment is strongest — it's consistent follow-up without breaks

strings.zh: 細菌感染、蜂窩性組織炎
水楊酸 + Imiquimod 樂得美
規律治療 4-6 次冷凍 + 居家水楊酸
strings.en: 4–6 sessions of regular cryotherapy + at-home salicylic acid

strings.zh: 能預防菜花(HPV 6/11)、子宮頸癌、肛門癌、口咽癌
strings.en: Prevents genital warts (HPV 6/11), cervical cancer, anal cancer, oropharyngeal cancer

strings.zh: 真正秘密不是「哪一招最強」
strings.en: The real secret isn't "which therapy is strongest"

strings.zh: 找對方法 + 規則持續、多管齊下
strings.en: Right method + consistent follow-through + combination therapy

strings.zh: 香蕉皮、雷射打一次、會自己好？
strings.en: Banana peel, single laser session, self-resolution?

strings.zh: 網站內容更正 / 學術引用詢問 / 媒體合作請寄：
strings.en: Content corrections / academic citation inquiries / media partnerships:

strings.zh: 1 次治癒率較高，但傷口大
strings.en: Single-session cure rate higher but wound larger

strings.zh: 誘發局部 TLR 免疫
中央硬芯、邊界平滑、單顆
strings.en: Central hard core, smooth border, solitary

strings.zh: 看到中央透明硬芯，不出血
strings.en: Reveals central translucent core, no bleeding

strings.zh: 側壓比直壓痛（pinch test 陽性）
strings.en: Lateral pinch hurts more than direct pressure (positive pinch test)

strings.zh: 冷凍 / 水楊酸 / Bleomycin 注射 / 雷射
strings.en: Cryotherapy / salicylic acid / bleomycin injection / laser

strings.zh: 磨除 + 換鞋減壓 + 矽膠墊

strings.en: Few small lesions, on extremities, pain-tolerant patient

strings.zh: 多顆 / 兒童 / 怕痛
水楊酸 40% 貼布長期 + 冷凍 / 雷射
strings.en: Long-term salicylic acid 40% patch + cryotherapy / laser

strings.zh: 皮膚科或泌尿婦科：Imiquimod / 冷凍 / 電燒 / 雷射 + 伴侶評估 + HPV 疫苗
strings.en: Dermatology or urology/gynecology: imiquimod / cryotherapy / electrocautery / laser + partner evaluation + HPV vaccine

strings.zh: 專科處理，可能需 Cidofovir、HPV 疫苗免疫療法
strings.en: Specialist management; may require cidofovir or HPV vaccine immunotherapy
